name: Chromium
description: The open-source browser behind Google Chrome, from Debian. Every site sees only this mini VM's exit, in its time zone.
changelog: Sound works (PulseAudio through PipeWire) and the microphone is available. V2Mac asks you the first time it plays sound or opens the microphone.
securityNotes: Clipboard for copy and paste, Shared for downloads and uploads, Sound and Microphone for video, music and calls; V2Mac asks before each is first used while it is open. Runs with --no-sandbox: the mini VM container allows no user namespaces or setuid, so Chromium's own sandbox can't start; the container and the mini VM are the isolation.
